title: 📜 Server Rules & Verification
description: Please read our community guidelines carefully. Respect fellow members and have fun!

fields.name: 1. Mutual Respect
fields.value: No toxic behavior, harassment, discrimination, or hate speech.

fields.name: 2. No Spam
fields.value: Avoid flood, excessive tagging, unsolicited ads, and referral links.

fields.name: 3. Channel Topics
fields.value: Keep discussions in their designated text and voice channels.

buttons.label: I Agree to Rules
buttons.response_text: ✅ Verification complete! Thank you for accepting the rules. Welcome aboard!
